protocol.buffers: Single and raw-batch paths have independent initially empty result vectors, retaining capacity across chunks and frames; visitor owns its bounded vectors per API call
protocol.preparation: Initial from_points only; prepare after updates only for frames containing queries
protocol.visitor_validation: Full independent membership validation once per group; oracle allocation, comparison and deallocation excluded; tree building, traversal, ID expansion, vector writes, dispatch and bookkeeping charged
protocol.time_interpretation: Summed kernel service intervals excluding oracle work, not end-to-end wall latency; output representations are explicitly distinct

interpretation: Spatial grouping avoids the severe loss from incoherent raw input-order chunks, but these concurrent numbers do not establish a general speedup; contained block discovery excludes consumer expansion and must not substitute for full exact ID reporting
